title: Divide the night running collection page into areas
goal: Marks headers, navigation, body text, and footers with semantic tags, allowing readers to locate by page area.
summary: The header, main body and footer of this active page are on the same layer. In-page navigation nav is placed in the header to facilitate readers to jump directly to the meeting point in the text.
tasks: Keep the outer div with class="sheet" and change the div containing the title to header.
Change the div outside the link to nav so that the navigation is located within the header and retain the link text and href.
Use main for the section containing the meeting point and footer for the maintenance information. Keep both at the same level as header, in the original order.

example.code:
shared tool room

Check opening hours

opening hours

Sunday 10:00 to 16:00.

Community volunteer maintenance
example.note: tool room page, put the opening hours in main, and write the person responsible for maintenance in the footer on the same layer.

hint: If the footer is included in the main text, check whether the end tag of main is written before footer.
